primary_person_group.description: Non-authoritative deterministic primary organizational route. A real command outranks staff/direct membership; command_person_groups preserves every command held.

staff_person_groups.description: Non-authoritative additive routing from exact person ref to command groups where that person holds a staff role. This never replaces primary_person_group.

command_person_groups.description: Non-authoritative person -> all exact command groups where that person is commander. Multiple commands are lawful; exact group records remain authority.
